description: The donut chart, labeled "(b) Agency A," illustrates the distribution of different task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations for a specific agency. The chart consists of two slices representing different task categories, which are visually ordered by descending size. The largest slice, colored salmon red, represents "Article generation" and accounts for 83.2% of the total. The smaller slice, colored yellow, represents "Headline generation" at 16.8%. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the category labels and their corresponding percentages are positioned outside the chart next to their respective slices. The center of the hollow chart contains the bolded text "Task Type," and there are no visually emphasized, exploded, or offset slices.
